# TechnoHealth

> Wearable health data infrastructure for digital health, research, longevity, and remote monitoring teams.

TechnoHealth turns wearable and smartphone data into trusted, analysis-ready health data — with provenance, data quality, and longitudinal routine context.

Website: https://www.technohealth.ca
Contact: https://www.technohealth.ca/contact
Book a demo: https://www.technohealth.ca/schedule-demo
Docs: https://www.technohealth.ca/docs
About: https://www.technohealth.ca/about

## What TechnoHealth does

- Connects wearable and smartphone data sources into one secure workspace
- Harmonizes formats and timelines across devices
- Preserves provenance, completeness, and missingness
- Prepares data for dashboards, analytics, ML models, and AI agents
- Helps teams see routines and behavioral patterns over time

## Who it is for

- Digital health & remote patient monitoring companies
- Research organizations
- Longevity & preventive-care clinics
- Health & life insurers
- Sports & performance teams
- Pharmaceutical study teams
- Gamification / challenge apps
